title: Monthly Clothing Swap
venue: Larcom City Hall, Basement, Conference Room
description:
Join the Office of Sustainability and Innovations for monthly clothing swaps on the third Thursday of each month! These are a perfect way to give your gently used clothes a new home. And you might just find an item of clothing you have been looking for, without having to buy it new.

​​How it works: Each person can bring up to 5 items of clothing in good condition (no rips, holes, stains, or unwashed items please!). Accessories are also welcome. You can take clothing without bringing anything, or bring clothing without taking anything. This is a completely free event.

title: 2026 Sustainability Forum: Climate Action for Renters – Breaking Barriers to Participation
venue: Ann Arbor District Library - Downtown Branch, 4th Floor Meeting Room
description: Join Ann Arbor's Office of Sustainability and Innovations for the third session of the 2026 Sustainability Forums to explore how renters can participate in Ann Arbor's energy programs. From the green rental housing ordinance to the home energy advisor program, the Sustainable Energy Utility, and beyond, come to learn and ask questions about how renters can participate in and benefit from climate action!

title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market Saturday Market Winter Hours!
Hop, Skip, Spring walk
description:
Hop on over ...

Join us for a free and fun walk around the loop at Gallup Park (3000 Fuller Road). Free but you must register in advance to attend. Participants can bring a basket and travel the path, stopping along the way to meet volunteers dressed as different animals. Each volunteer will invite participants to complete a quick, playful challenge, such as hopping like a bunny, twirling in a circle, or trying a short hula hoop spin. After completing the task, participants will receive a small treat or toy before continuing along the route. When participants finish the loop, they can enjoy a simple craft activity, take a photo with Hopps the Bunny and visit with real bunnies on site. Environmental Education staff will also host a bunny-themed story time from 10-11 a.m. Volunteers will be needed.
